title: Packaged Food Promotion Workflows: Coordinate Retail Commitments and Ecommerce Launches
summary: Bring retail commitments, NetSuite supply evidence, and Shopify launch dates into one promotion record so a snack offer is approved against promised stock.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Coordinate a food promotion around approved commitments, item readiness, and channel launch decisions. A workflow should show when retail quantities are committed and what evidence supports the ecommerce launch, without treating all physically present stock as freely available. Keep commercial approval and any inventory action explicit.


Explore the complete[packaged food and snacks integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg/packaged-food-snacks) for the systems and processes around this guide.
